H3000.def: from «01288» and «03050»: blessed of Jah; Jeberekjah, an Israelite:--Jeberechiah.

H3001.def: a primitive root; to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage):--be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), × utterly, wither (away).

H3003.def: the same as «03002» (also Yabeysh {yaw-bashe'}; often with the addition of «01568», i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Jobesh ((-Gilead)).

H3005.def: from the same as «01314»; fragrant; Jibsam, an Israelite:--Jibsam.

H3006.def: a variation of «03004»; dry ground:--dry land.

H3008.def: from «01350»; avenger; Jigal, the name of three Israelites:--Igal, Igeal.

H3009.def: a primitive root; to dig or plow:--husbandman.

H3011.def: feminine from «01361»; hillock; Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan:--Jogbehah.

H3012.def: from «01431» and «03050»; magnified of Jah; Jigdaljah, an Israelite:--Igdaliah.

H3013.def: a primitive root; to grieve:--afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

H3014.et: a primitive root [probably rather the same as (03013) through thecommon idea of dissatisfaction]
H3014.def: a primitive root (probably rather the same as «03013» through the common idea of dissatisfaction); to push away; -be removed.

H3017.def: probably from «01481»; a lodging; Jagur, a place in Palestine:--Jagur.

H3018.def: from «03021»; toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor):--labour, work.

H3021.def: a primitive root; properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil:--faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.

H3022.def: from «03021»; earnings (as the product of toil); -that which he laboured for.

H3023.def: from «03021»; tired; hence (transitive) tiresome:--full of labour, weary.

H3025.def: a primitive root; to fear:--be afraid, fear.

H3026.et: from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to (07717)
H3026.def: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to «07717»; heap of the testimony; Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan:--Jegar-Sahadutha.

H3027.def: a primitive word; a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.), in distinction from «03709», the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows):--(+ be) able, × about, + armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, × bounty, + broad, (broken-)handed, × by, charge, coast, + consecrate, + creditor, custody, debt, dominion, × enough, + fellowship, force, × from, hand(-staves, -y work), × he, himself, × in, labour, + large, ledge, (left-)handed, means, × mine, ministry, near, × of, × order, ordinance, × our, parts, pain, power, × presumptuously, service, side, sore, st

H3030.def: of uncertain derivation; Jidalah, a place in Palestine:--Idalah.

H3031.def: from the same as «01706»; perhaps honeyed; Jidbash, an Israelite:--Idbash.

H3032.def: a primitive root; properly, to handle (compare «03034»), i.e. to throw, e.g. lots:--cast.

H3033.def: from «03039»; properly, affection; concretely, a darling object:--dearly beloved.

H3034.et: a primitive root; used only as denominative from (03027)
H3034.def: a primitive root; used only as denominative from «03027»; literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand; physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands):--cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).

H3037.def: from «03045»; knowing; Jaddua, the name of two Israelites:--Jaddua.

H3038.def: or Yduthuwn {yed-oo-thoon'}; or Ydiythuwn {yed-ee-thoon'}; probably from «03034»; laudatory; Jeduthun, an Israelite:--Jeduthun.

H3039.def: from the same as «01730»; loved:--amiable, (well-)beloved, loves.

H3040.def: feminine of «03039»; beloved; Jedidah, an Israelitess:--Jedidah.

H3041.def: from «03039» and «03050»; beloved of Jah; Jedidejah, a name of Solomon:--Jedidiah.

H3042.def: from «03034» and «03050»; praised of Jah; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:--Jedaiah.

H3043.def: from «03045» and «0410»; knowing God; Jediael, the name of three Israelites:--Jediael.

H3045.def: a primitive root; to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.) (as follow):--acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-)awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, × could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-)norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be,

H3046.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03045»:--certify, know, make known, teach.

H3048.def: from «03045» and «03050»; Jah has known; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:--Jedaiah.

H3049.def: from «03045»; properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost:--wizard.

H3050.et: contraction for (03068), and meaning the same
H3050.def: contraction for «03068», and meaning the same; Jah, the sacred name:--Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in "-iah," "- jah."

H3051.def: a primitive root; to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come:--ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.

H3052.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03051»; -deliver, give, lay, + prolong, pay, yield.

H3053.def: from «03051»; properly, what is given (by Providence), i.e. a lot:--burden.

H3054.et: denominative from a form corresponding to (03061)
H3054.def: denominative from a form corresponding to «03061»; to Judaize, i.e. become Jewish:--become Jews.

H3055.et: a briefer form of one corresponding to (03061)
H3055.def: a briefer form of one corresponding to «03061»; Jehud, a place in Palestine:--Jehud.

H3056.et: perhaps from a form corresponding to (03061)
H3056.def: perhaps from a form corresponding to «03061»; Judaistic; Jehdai, an Israelite:--Jehdai.

H3058.def: from «03068» and «01931»; Jehovah (is) He; Jehu, the name of five Israelites:--Jehu.

H3059.def: from «03068» and «0270»; Jehovah-seized; Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites:--Jehoahaz. Compare «03099».

H3060.def: from «03068» and (perhaps) «0784»; Jehovah-fired; Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings:--Jehoash. Compare «03101».

H3061.et: contracted from a form corresponding to (03063)
H3061.def: (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to «03063»; properly, Judah, hence, Judaea:--Jewry, Judah, Judea.

H3062.def: (Aramaic) patrial from «03061»; a Jehudaite (or Judaite), i.e. Jew:--Jew.

H3063.def: from «03034»; celebrated; Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory:--Judah.

H3064.def: patronymically from «03063»; a Jehudite (i.e. Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (i.e. Judah):--Jew.

H3065.def: the same as «03064»; Jehudi, an Israelite:--Jehudi.

H3066.def: feminine of «03064»; the Jewish (used adverbially) language:--in the Jews' language.

H3067.def: the same as «03066»; Jewess; Jehudith, a Canaanitess:--Judith.

H3068.def: from «01961»; (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jehovah, Jewish national name of God:--Jehovah, the Lord. Compare «03050», «03069».

H3069.et: a variation of ((03068)) [used after ((0136)), and pronounced by Jews as (0430), in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce 03068 as 0136]
H3069.def: a variation of «03068» (used after «0136», and pronounced by Jews as «0430», in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce «03068» as «0136»):--God.

H3070.def: from «03068» and «07200»; Jehovah will see (to it); Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah:--Jehovah- jireh.

H3071.et: from (03068) and (05251) with the prononimal suffix
H3071.def: from «03068» and «05251» with the prononimal suffix; Jehovah (is) my banner; Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert:--Jehovah-nissi.

H3072.def: from «03068» and «06664» with pronominal suffix; Jehovah (is) our right; Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem:--the Lord our righteousness.

H3073.def: from «03068» and «07965»; Jehovah (is) peace; Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine: -Jehovah-shalom.

H3074.def: from «03068» and «08033» with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither; Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolic title of Jerusalem:--Jehovah-shammah.

H3075.def: from «03068» and «02064»; Jehovah-endowed; Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites:--Jehozabad. Compare «03107».

H3076.def: from «03068» and «02603»; Jehovah-favored; Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites:--Jehohanan, Johanan. Compare «03110».

H3077.def: from «03068» and «03045»; Jehovah-known; Jehojada, the name of three Israelites:--Jehoiada. Compare «03111».

H3078.def: from «03068» and «03559»; Jehovah will establish; Jehojakin, a Jewish king:--Jehoiachin. Compare «03112».

H3079.def: from «03068» abbreviated and «06965»; Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king:--Jehoiakim. Compare «03113».

H3080.def: from «03068» and «07378»; Jehovah will contend; Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites:--Jehoiarib. Compare «03114».

H3081.def: from «03201»; potent; Jehukal, an Israelite: -Jehucal. Compare «03116».

H3082.def: from «03068» and «05068»; Jehovah-largessed; Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab:--Jehonadab, Jonadab. Compare «03122».

H3083.def: from «03068» and «05414»; Jehovah-given; Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites:--Jonathan. Compare «03129».

H3084.def: a fuller form of «03130»; Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob:--Joseph.

H3085.def: from «03068» and «05710»; Jehovah-adorned; Jehoaddah, an Israelite:--Jehoada.

H3086.def: or Yhowaddan {yeh-ho-ad-dawn'}; from «03068» and «05727»; Jehovah-pleased; Jehoaddin or Jehoaddan, an Israelitess:--Jehoaddan.

H3087.def: from «03068» and «06663»; Jehovah-righted; Jehotsadak, an Israelite:--Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare «03136».

H3088.def: from «03068» and «07311»; Jehovah-raised; Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites:--Jehoram, Joram. Compare «03141».

H3089.def: from «03068» and «07650»; Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba, an Israelitess:--Jehosheba. Compare «03090».

H3090.def: a form of «03089»; Jehoshabath, an Israelitess:--Jehoshabeath.

H3091.def: or Yhowshua {yeh-ho-shoo'-ah}; from «03068» and «03467»; Jehovah-saved; Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader:--Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare «01954», «03442».

H3092.def: from «03068» and «08199»; Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem:--Jehoshaphat. Compare «03146».

H3093.def: probably from the same as «02022»; elated; hence, arrogant:--haughty, proud.

H3094.def: from «01984» and «0410»; praising God; Jehallelel, the name of two Israelites:--Jehalellel, Jehalelel.

H3095.def: from «01986» (in the sense of hardness); a precious stone, probably onyx:--diamond.

H3096.et: from an unused root meaning to stamp
H3096.def: or Yahtsah {yah'-tsaw}; or (feminine) Yahtsah {yah-tsaw'}; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor; Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan:--Jahaz, Jahazah, Jahzah.

H3097.def: from «03068» and «01»; Jehovah-fathered; Joab, the name of three Israelites:--Joab.

H3098.def: from «03068» and «0251»; Jehovah-brothered; Joach, the name of four Israelites:--Joah.

H3099.def: a form of «03059»; Joachaz, the name of two Israelites:--Jehoahaz, Joahaz.
